mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment growth signals a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS grows, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing and industrial sectors, which typically leads to reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP growth and housing starts signal a severe economic slowdown, which typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 450000), the market expects sustained economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 450000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
